title: Worksheet 11: Reporting and Blocking Tools (V2.0)
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: Roblox provides built-in tools that let players report and block other users who are behaving inappropriately or making them feel unsafe. The "block" feature prevents a specific player from being able to message, chat with, or interact with another player again, which can be useful if someone is being unkind or making a player uncomfortable. The "report" feature is different: it sends information about a problem directly to Roblox's safety team, who can review the situation and take action, such as removing inappropriate content or suspending an account that has broken the platform's rules. Reporting is important even if a player has already blocked someone, because reporting can help protect other players who might interact with the same person in the future. When reporting, it is helpful to include as much detail as possible, such as what happened and when, since this makes it easier for Roblox's safety team to investigate the situation properly.
